ES-001.note: EditorSource shares the RasterSource native decoder, with header limits before pixel allocation, chunk-level cancellation, original file-byte snapshots and typed diagnostics. EditorSourceTest verifies unsupported/empty inputs, oversized BMP header rejection before decode, PNG alpha/profile preservation and untouched files. Native editor, tray and CLI loading now run on a progress/cancellation worker. Raster and sidecar encoded inputs are bounded to 1 GiB before buffering and during growth; source loading/hashing checks cancellation before publishing any document. Sparse oversized-file and staged cancellation tests verify typed errors, empty unpublished results and unchanged files.

ES-002.note: Orientation is normalized once with QImageReader auto-transform and pixels remain non-premultiplied ARGB32. Independent EXIF/JPEG mapping tests verify embedded PNG orientation; PNG tests preserve alpha and colour metadata. New Image converts initial pixels/background to an explicitly selected profile, retaining immutable source bytes. Editor canvas and comparison use private sRGB display copies, with independent linear/sRGB pixel and native-view tests. End-to-end annotation composition in the working profile and requested export-profile conversion remain pending. Open prepares its private sRGB display cache on the worker before session adoption; independent linear-to-sRGB transfer and alpha tests verify unchanged source pixels/profile.

ES-004.note: Native selection outline and hit testing follow rotation. Pointer and keyboard move, Alt+arrow resize, R/Shift+R quarter turns, a cancellable Rotate selection dialog for arbitrary angles, ordering, and Delete are available. Rotation commits one session history entry.

ES-006.note: Undo and redo restore the selection each state had (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp). Canvas history restores the source PNG and dimensions plus annotations and selection; CanvasOperationsTest and EditorWindowTest cover crop, resize and whole-image rotation.

ES-007.note: History snapshots hold immutable, implicitly shared source PNG and assets. Canvas edits create a separate encoded source before committing; undo/redo never modify a reachable prior source. Allocation is reserved before truncating the redo branch. New sessions distinguish saved and unsaved initial sources; immutable initial pixels survive Undo and have no clean checkpoint until successful persistence. New Image replacement reserves a complete fresh session before confirmation and preserves the existing history on cancel or incomplete save; adopting a new document intentionally discards the old history only after Save/Discard confirmation.

ES-008.note: Escape cancels a draw or move gesture. Native dirty close and New/Open Image replacement offer Save, Discard and Cancel; replacement defaults to Cancel and waits for fully validated preparation. Untitled images are dirty without prior edits and Save prompts for a PNG destination. Native window tests verify cancelled close/replacement/destination, successful save/discard, failed raster or sidecar save, preserved prior source/history/selection/viewport and rebound canvas actions. The editor remains alive until modal preparation workers finish. Native Open tests also verify same-file and untitled overlapping Save reload the persisted source/sidecar, while cancelled pickers, loading and invalid sources preserve the current session. Canvas teardown occurs while its referenced session/image remain alive.

ES-009.note: The authoritative PNG compositor and atomic save preserve the source colour profile. Native tests verify profile and alpha across canvas edits, New Image creation and persisted PNG/sidecar reopening. Annotation colour composition for non-sRGB sources, additional export formats, requested profile conversion and cross-platform golden coverage remain pending.

ES-011.note: Native save uses QSaveFile atomic raster replacement and marks the checkpoint only after raster and required sidecar persistence succeed. New Image tests verify a blank initial source stays dirty until a successful destination save, and failed raster/sidecar persistence prevents dirty replacement. Full save/output qualification remains pending.

ES-012.note: A sidecar failure keeps the session dirty and reports sidecar-save-failed (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp). Native replacement tests force a sidecar write failure after raster persistence, report Save incomplete, and retain the current editable session/history/selection/checkpoint.

ES-013.note: gzip-wrapped UTF-8 JSON with schema fields round-trips. Native load/save computes raster SHA-256, embeds immutable unannotated PNG and records timestamps. New Image starts without file identity and retains the selected profile through PNG/xann round trips. Full document compatibility qualification remains pending.

ES-015.note: Unknown additive fields and annotation types round-trip in the core. Native opening fails closed for newer, unreadable or corrupt sidecars and embedded sources. Unsupported objects are shown as labelled, accessible native dock placeholders, including hidden state, and survive flatten/clear undo. Core, file and window tests verify preservation, failure without rewriting and placeholder presentation.

ES-016.note: Qt Core SourceBinding requires an explicit current-raster or embedded-source choice when hashes differ. The native warning offers both validated images with dimensions and Cancel as default. Cancellation creates no session; choices preserve annotation fields/coordinates/assets and use the validated snapshots without rereading files. Core, file and native-dialog tests cover choices, changed dimensions, cancellation, snapshot stability and untouched files. Native opening and choice resolution run on cancellable workers, including private current/embedded display preparation, and never publish a usable session after cancellation.

ES-017.note: Strict base64, PNG signature and IHDR limits, duplicate IDs, and finite numbers are checked before decode (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp).

ES-019.note: Canvas is focusable with a visible focus ring, accessible names, a dashed two-tone selection outline, fixed-width outlines and six-screen-pixel hit targets under zoom. Native tests cover low-zoom selection. Toolbars and scrollbars are keyboard reachable; screen-reader annotation state and full high-contrast review remain pending. New Image fields have native labels/buddies and accessible names, keyboard operation and a named progress control; native accessibility interfaces verify the dimensions name and Linux profile label relation/current value.

ES-020.note: Temp and recovery retention arrive with the save path and recovery.

ES-022.note: Structural and history vectors pass. Shared golden-image vectors await approved fixtures.

ES-025.note: Quarter turns retain the binary64 box-coverage path; all other finite angles use exact polygon/pixel intersections with fill-before-stroke and one opacity application. Analytical diamond coverage, inner-stroke subtraction, and compositing are checked in tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp; tests/EditorSourceTest.cpp verifies a 17-degree PNG/sidecar save and reopen. Shared golden fixtures remain an ES-022 activation gate.

ES-027.note: Saved sessions retain stable checkpoint IDs. Newly created sources use an absent initial checkpoint, so Undo to initial pixels remains dirty until successful persistence. EditorSessionTest and EditorWindowTest verify unsaved initial/Undo/Redo, cancelled Save and complete/incomplete native persistence.

ES-028.note: Canvas and embedded-image limits are checked from JSON and PNG headers; readXann stops inflating at the JSON byte limit (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/EditorSessionTest.cpp).

ES-029.note: Document diagnostics follow the required priority and sidecar-save-failed and raster-save-failed are reported; the source-* diagnostics arrive with the source loader.

ES-030.note: The baseline fallback convention still needs runtime observation before activation, as ES-030 requires.
